collection: Explicit user authorization to complete only preregistered DEV32 using unchanged 5c8f8e4f5cd478c793a0e0d9640005deaf700973 collector; preserve failures
checkpoint_policy: Existing expanded191 generator seed0 fixed-last3000 and already packaged q seed0/calibration; no reselection, retraining or tuning on DEV32
metric: Ordered directed crossings of each of the two physical row centre planes by the complete piecewise-linear 3D route. Each crossing is negative_y/middle/positive_y if laterally outside expanded posts; otherwise above/below the intersected post. Adjacent inverse crossings of the same portal cancel recursively, removing small backtracking. Same reduced word is one mode, regardless of manual labels or geometric jitter. Half-open crossing convention prevents duplicate vertices. Physical boxes and original 2cm clearance are evaluation only.
shape_scope: Full 3D polyline and ordered obstacle-passage relations, not endpoint distance. Finite portal modes, not a proof of homotopy classes; misses excursions that never cross a row plane. No distance threshold or data-fitted clustering parameters.
reference: Check original H24 reference validity with unchanged checker; group all accepted references including unknown with the same rule. Coverage is fraction of discovered reference words hit, macro averaged only over conditions with >=2 reference modes; not full real distribution.
selection: Unchanged deployed q-first selector, q>=0.5 and mean vertex distance>=0.04, then fill by q; no oracle portal word enters deployed selection
collapse_gate: On old DEV balanced seed0, at least half of conditions with >=2 reference modes have exactly one valid full-pool mode, and at least six such conditions. Zero-valid pools reported separately, not called collapse. Gate is descriptive on reused DEV.
uncertainty: 10000 paired parent bootstrap draws, seed 20261004; same-parent conditions kept together
budget: No new search. Evaluation/code tests capped at 3600 cumulative seconds; optional one relation generator seed0 capped at 3000 updates, then replication only for positive gate. Collection original 32-parent/864-slot budget and 8GiB corpus cap unchanged.
